query: SELECT cm.slug, cm.title, cm.estimatedHours, COUNT(cl.id) as lesson_count, SUM(cl.estimatedMinutes) as total_minutes FROM course_modules cm LEFT JOIN course_lessons cl ON cl.moduleId = cm.id GROUP BY cm.id ORDER BY cm.id
